description: This file declares the Timer class in the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace, which manages timer-related functionalities including starting, canceling, suspending timers, and event notifications. It includes enums for timer states and modes, a TimerItem struct, and method declarations for timer operations and JSON-RPC communication handling.

classes.name: Timer
classes.description: A plugin class that manages timers and provides JSON-RPC interface for controlling timers and sending timer-related notifications.

methods.name: startTimerWrapper
methods.description: Handles the JSON-RPC request to start a timer.

methods.name: cancelWrapper
methods.description: Handles the JSON-RPC request to cancel a timer.

methods.name: suspendWrapper
methods.description: Handles the JSON-RPC request to suspend a timer.

methods.name: resumeWrapper
methods.description: Handles the JSON-RPC request to resume a suspended timer.

methods.name: getTimerStatusWrapper
methods.description: Handles the JSON-RPC request to get the status of a specific timer.

methods.name: getTimersWrapper
methods.description: Handles the JSON-RPC request to retrieve all timers.

methods.name: sendTimerExpired
methods.description: Sends a notification when a timer expires.

methods.name: sendTimerExpiryReminder
methods.description: Sends a reminder notification before a timer expires.

methods.name: checkTimers
methods.description: Checks the current timers and updates their states.

methods.name: startTimer
methods.description: Starts a timer given its ID.

methods.name: cancelTimer
methods.description: Cancels a timer given its ID.

methods.name: suspendTimer
methods.description: Suspends a timer given its ID.

methods.name: onTimerCallback
methods.description: Callback function invoked when a timer event occurs.

methods.name: getTimerStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of a specific timer.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given shell.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns static information about the plugin.
